lessons: When run_seq is given, carry it into the spool path as well as the effect key: pass a spool stem like f"{surface}/{run_seq}" to every self.spool.write call in Driver.run. Leave the ticket and existing ticketless paths byte-identical so tests/test_driver.py passes unedited.
In tests/test_triage.py, assert that each triage pass writes to a separate spool dir per message: two messages in one pass must not share a prompt.md or output.txt path.

Criterion 2: assert r.tier == config.routing_default_tier for every llm.requests entry. Then read the journal's LLM effect events and assert the key set equals {f"llm/triage/{m.seq}/triage/0/1"} for the three messages. Distinct rendered text alone does not prove this.

Before finishing, check each acceptance criterion against a specific assertion in the tests. Every criterion clause, such as tier, keys, or spool dir, needs an explicit check. Passing tests are not enough.
